name: segment-anything
summary: Foundation segmentation service for promptable object segmentation in images and related vision workflows.
why_it_matters: Segment Anything preserves a strong computer-vision capability for future use, but there is no current validated scenario that justifies keeping the service as an actively maintained resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs object segmentation with minimal prompt engineering.
Operators want reusable segmentation primitives for vision pipelines.
The workflow depends on mask generation rather than only classification or detection.

platform_support.notes: The service can run in containers, but model size, GPU acceleration, and runtime dependencies make support uneven across environments.

implementation_notes: Promotion should validate a real segmentation workflow with representative inputs.
Keep model lifecycle and artifact handling explicit.
Do not imply production support unless inference behavior is tested end to end.
operational_notes: Model download size and runtime cost matter.
Validation should run real segmentation examples with expected outputs.
GPU capability differences strongly affect operator experience.
risks: Foundation-model wrappers drift quickly if unused.
Inference support can look portable while performance is not.
